tool_input.command: ls runs/ | tail -5; ls runs/*experiment16*/ runs/*experiment18*/; sqlite3 experiments.sqlite "select id, length(arch_svg) from experiments order by id desc limit 5"
sqlite3 /Users/alexisrondeau/Workshop/low-light-geolocalization-autoresearch/experiments.sqlite "select id, length(arch_svg) from experiments order by id desc limit 5"

D=runs/20261101_223250_experiment19 && cat > $D/make_fig.py <<'EOF'
import json, sys
src, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
s = json.load(open(src))["architecture_svg"]
reps = [
 ("32×28²", "40×28²"),
 ("96×14²</text>", "112×14²</text>"),
 ("NEW — MobileNetV2 trunk A", "NEW — EfficientNet-B0 trunk A"),
 ("NEW — MobileNetV2 trunk B", "NEW — EfficientNet-B0 trunk B"),
 ("17 blocks · GAP of 96×14², 320×7²", "7 MBConv+SE stages · GAP of 112×14², 320×7²"),
 ("MixStyle after blocks 3, 6, 10 (same strides) · CosFace m=0.25 · trunk at 0.1× LR — unchanged from exp 15",
  "MixStyle after stages 2, 3, 4 (same strides) · CosFace m=0.25 · trunk at 0.1× LR — unchanged from exp 16"),
 ("only the trunk changed: ImageNet MobileNetV2 (BSD-3) · decode, gate, losses unchanged",
  "only the trunk changed: ImageNet EfficientNet-B0 (Apache-2.0) · decode, gate, losses unchanged"),
]
for a, b in reps:
    assert a in s, a
    s = s.replace(a, b)
json.dump({"architecture_svg": s}, open(out, "w"), ensure_ascii=False)
open(out.replace(".json", ".svg"), "w").write(s)
EOF
.venv/bin/python -I $D/make_fig.py runs/20261101_191341_experiment16/figure.json $D/figure.json && rsvg-convert -w 1600 -b white $D/figure.svg -o $D/figure.png && .venv/bin/python -m autoresearch.figcheck $D/figure.json

result:
The architecture figure for experiment 19 is saved to `runs/20261101_223250_experiment19/figure.json`. figcheck prints PASS, and I rendered it and checked the picture: no text collisions, nothing cut off at the edges, and the input and output sit level on the centre line.

Experiment 19 changes only the trunk, so I started from experiment 16's figure (the champion's) and relabelled it rather than drawing it from scratch:
- **Both trunks (red, the one change):** now "EfficientNet-B0 trunk A/B", with the sub-note "7 MBConv+SE stages · GAP of 112×14², 320×7²".
- **Feature-map shapes:** 40×28² and 112×14², replacing MobileNetV2's 32×28² and 96×14².
- **Training lane:** MixStyle now sits after stages 2, 3 and 4, and the lane reads "unchanged from exp 16".
- **Footer:** names ImageNet EfficientNet-B0 (Apache-2.0).

Everything else is experiment 16's drawing unchanged. That includes the training lane's "bf16 autocast on CUDA only" note, which I didn't re-check against experiment 19's code; the design says training is otherwise unchanged.

The relabelling script (`make_fig.py`) and the rendered `figure.svg` and `figure.png` are in the same run folder.
